analysis.summary: They want an analyst who can turn messy operations into clear processes, controls and quick prototypes, and bring senior stakeholders along.

Designed an interim operating model for a payments team

analysis.strategy: You are positioned as a transformation consultant who already maps processes, controls and operating models in financial services. Your build tools lead the skills section, but prepare a concrete prototype example for the interview.

Prepared steering committee packs and presented progress to Director-level stakeholders every fortnight
